data.rationale: The proposal gets the core goal (open a Special Events listing, pick the event, set ticket count, click Book Now/Reserve Now), but it omits the city and date parameters, adds event name and ticket type, and leaves the steps vague ("event or venue", "continue through any next steps"), so a browser automation couldn't be built from it alone.
